residual_review_items: Four shipped native objects match exact official wheels. This does not constitute an independently reproduced native build or an attestation verification of the complete wheel toolchain.
The crate catalog is deduplicated by name/version. SBOM presence is not proof that every entry is embedded at runtime; direct build dependency flags are classification aids only.

Original upstream license texts and all declared alternatives are preserved. AND/OR expressions and which obligations apply to the delivered combination remain a release-review decision; no upstream license is replaced by the project GPL choice.

The certifi CA bundle is byte-identical in the shipped payload, official wheel, sdist and pinned upstream Git source. Its generator calls mkcert.org; the original Mozilla certdata revision and a reproducible generation chain were not identified. Preferred-source/legal classification remains an explicit review item.
This supplement must accompany an identifiable distribution and its matching FrameBridge source. Private collection alone is not a public source offer or a complete legal compliance certification.
